description: Causal clause markers that link UOL atoms. Each marker maps to a causal relation and the direction of the link between the clause it introduces and the other clause in the utterance.

because.description: The clause introduced by 'because' is the cause of the main clause.

since.description: The clause introduced by 'since' is the cause of the main clause.

so.description: The clause introduced by 'so' is the effect of the main clause.

therefore.description: The clause introduced by 'therefore' is the effect of the main clause.

if.description: The clause introduced by 'if' is the cause of the main clause.

lead.description: The subject leads to the object.
